_purpose: Tracked immutable Stage E gate threshold registry (Codex 2026-08-15 3rd pass P1). Each entry binds an identifier to a specific (x_a, x_b, min_high_support, min_denominator) quadruple. Only entries with frozen=true grant Stage F eligibility. Draft entries never do. Any change to a frozen entry's values MUST bump the id and set frozen=false initially, then a separate owner review re-freezes it.

_contract.x_a_range: [0.0, 1.0] — fractional improvement over uniform required; higher = stricter
_contract.x_b_range: [0.0, 1.0] — fractional MSE degradation vs teacher tolerated; lower = stricter
_contract.min_high_support_range: positive integer; per-(band, component) minimum row count

entries.notes: Initial draft values per docs/gap_net_v3_plan.md §16 revised 2026-08-12. NOT frozen — pending Batch 5 owner review. Any run using this id will be Stage F ineligible.
